== Summary ==
Published-layout comparison for [[Kin Kian (V)|Kin Kian (V) (Errata 3)]]. Left: [[:File:V7-L-kinkian.gif]], with exterior top padding cropped. Right: [[:File:V7-L-kinkian-Set7-September-2023-partial.png]], using its original PDF mask. Card pixels were not repainted or completed; blank surroundings are comparison-canvas background. Original source [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf]], page 3. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original images published by the Players Committee.
